import { CLIENT_EXPORT_MANIFEST, CLIENT_EXPORT_FILES } from '../../../stellar/scf-starforge-20261009/sf30-seller-sdk/developer/client-export-contracts.mjs';
import { MAX_RETAINED_CHUNK_BYTES } from '../retained-file-contracts.mjs';

const digest = { type: 'string', pattern: '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' };

const alias = { type: 'string', pattern: '^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,39}$' };

const tenant = { type: 'string', pattern: '^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,39}$' };

const release = { type: 'string', pattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,63}$' };

const identity = { type: 'string', minLength: 1, maxLength: 128 };

const revision = { type: 'integer', minimum: 1 };

function fleetClientTools(tool) {
  const scope = { tenant, slot: alias }, selected = { ...scope, exportId: release };
  return [
    tool('merchant_fleet_client_list', 'List original retained customer SDK exports for one declared merchant and slot. Completion receipts and interrupted exports remain available when that slot is stopped.',
      { ...scope, after: release, limit: { type: 'integer', minimum: 1, maximum: 50 } }, ['tenant', 'slot'], { readOnly: true, idempotent: true }),
    tool('merchant_fleet_client_status', 'Inspect the original five customer files, exact saved payment terms, completion receipt and release provenance for this merchant and slot.',
      selected, ['tenant', 'slot', 'exportId'], { readOnly: true, idempotent: true }),
    tool('merchant_fleet_client_generate', 'Generate the original customer SDK from this exact fleet-owned merchant instance into a new retained export ID. Read the actual slot instanceId from merchant_fleet_status; the source is its live original OpenAPI.',
      { ...scope, id: release, instanceId: identity }, ['tenant', 'slot', 'id', 'instanceId']),
    tool('merchant_fleet_client_adopt', 'Retain a completion receipt for the inspected original five legacy customer files in this slot. Requires their exact complete files digest and preserves all payload bytes.',
      { ...selected, expectedFilesSha256: digest }, ['tenant', 'slot', 'exportId', 'expectedFilesSha256'], { idempotent: true }),
    tool('merchant_fleet_client_manifest', 'Read the original customer completion manifest and its exact identity in this merchant and slot. Use its SHA-256 to select retained file downloads.',
      selected, ['tenant', 'slot', 'exportId'], { readOnly: true, idempotent: true }),
    tool('merchant_fleet_client_file', 'Read bounded SHA-pinned original customer bytes within one declared merchant, slot and export. Continue using readId, offset and inspected hashes; released or expired reads can reopen the same immutable bytes.',
      { ...selected, file: { type: 'string', enum: [CLIENT_EXPORT_MANIFEST, ...CLIENT_EXPORT_FILES] },
        expectedManifestSha256: digest, expectedSha256: digest, readId: identity,
        offset: { type: 'integer', minimum: 0 }, limit: { type: 'integer', minimum: 1, maximum: MAX_RETAINED_CHUNK_BYTES } },
      ['tenant', 'slot', 'exportId', 'file', 'expectedManifestSha256'], { readOnly: true, idempotent: true }),
    tool('merchant_fleet_client_file_release', 'Release only this merchant and slot’s temporary original customer file read. The retained customer files and completion receipt remain available.',
      { ...selected, readId: identity }, ['tenant', 'slot', 'exportId', 'readId'], { readOnly: true, idempotent: true }),
  ];
}

function fleetDiscoveryTools(tool) {
  const scope = { tenant, slot: alias, instanceId: identity };
  const page = {
    view: { type: 'string', enum: ['list', 'search'] },
    limit: { type: 'integer', minimum: 1, maximum: 100 },
    offset: { type: 'integer', minimum: 0, maximum: 9999999 },
    query: { type: 'string', minLength: 1, maxLength: 1024 },
    cursor: { type: 'string', minLength: 1, maxLength: 512 },
    network: { type: 'string', enum: ['stellar:testnet', 'stellar:pubnet'] },
    type: { type: 'string', enum: ['http', 'mcp'] },
    scheme: { type: 'string', maxLength: 256 }, payTo: { type: 'string', maxLength: 256 },
    extensions: { type: 'string', maxLength: 256 },
  };
  return [
    tool('merchant_fleet_discovery_status', 'Read one tenant’s original seller enrollment, serving release and instance, exact payment terms, catalogue head and original buyer explorer. The signing identity belongs to the tenant across release slots. Interrupted setup includes its inspected recovery identity.',
      { tenant }, ['tenant'], { readOnly: true, idempotent: true }),
    tool('merchant_fleet_discovery_enrollment', 'Read the original public seller enrollment and pinned public key for this tenant, with its original source and accepted origin, recipients, networks and schemes.',
      { tenant }, ['tenant'], { readOnly: true, idempotent: true }),
    tool('merchant_fleet_discovery_enrollment_review', 'Review the exact serving tenant release, actual offers and source-derived permissions before original seller enrollment. For an incomplete setup, pass expectedIncompleteId from current status to review preservation of its partial files followed by enrollment.',
      { ...scope, sellerId: { type: 'string', pattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{1,128}$' },
        sourceURL: { type: 'string', minLength: 1, maxLength: 4096 }, expectedIncompleteId: digest },
      ['tenant', 'slot', 'instanceId', 'sellerId'], { readOnly: true }),
    tool('merchant_fleet_discovery_enroll', 'Create this tenant’s original seller identity from the exact enrollment review. The current routing guard spans original setup. A reviewed incomplete setup is preserved intact before creating its replacement; completed enrollment reopens its existing identity.',
      { tenant, reviewId: identity }, ['tenant', 'reviewId']),
    tool('merchant_fleet_discovery_start', 'Start or reopen this tenant’s original signed catalogue and its original SF61 buyer explorer. Reuses the retained seller identity and journal across blue/green deployments.',
      { tenant }, ['tenant'], { idempotent: true }),
    tool('merchant_fleet_discovery_stop', 'Close this process-owned tenant buyer explorer and catalogue using its exact discovery instanceId. Retains the original enrollment, signed revisions and withdrawals for reopen.',
      { tenant, instanceId: identity }, ['tenant', 'instanceId'], { destructive: true }),
    tool('merchant_fleet_discovery_source', 'Inspect the actual offers, payment choices and catalogue differences of one retained tenant release, including a stopped slot. Select an older route that a replacement release removed.',
      { tenant, slot: alias, releaseId: release }, ['tenant', 'slot', 'releaseId'], { readOnly: true, idempotent: true }),
    tool('merchant_fleet_discovery_review', 'Review exact signed publication or withdrawal against the tenant’s original catalogue head and current serving instance. Publishing uses the serving release. A withdrawal may select sourceSlot/sourceReleaseId for an older retained route, with a concrete reason.',
      { ...scope, action: { type: 'string', enum: ['publish', 'withdraw'] },
        routeId: { type: 'string', minLength: 1, maxLength: 256 },
        reason: { type: 'string', minLength: 1, maxLength: 256 }, sourceSlot: alias, sourceReleaseId: release },
      ['tenant', 'slot', 'instanceId', 'action'], { readOnly: true }),
    tool('merchant_fleet_discovery_apply', 'Apply the exact reviewed tenant publication or withdrawal using the original signer and transaction journal. The current routing lock spans signatures and commit. After a lost response, read current status/history to reconcile its durable result.',
      { tenant, reviewId: identity }, ['tenant', 'reviewId']),
    tool('merchant_fleet_discovery_history', 'Read this tenant resource’s original signed lifecycle and journal head, including price revisions and withdrawals. Remains available after the release slot retires and the retained catalogue reopens.',
      { tenant, catalogKey: { type: 'string', minLength: 1, maxLength: 4096 } },
      ['tenant', 'catalogKey'], { readOnly: true, idempotent: true }),
    tool('merchant_fleet_discovery_consume', 'Read an actual page from this tenant’s original SF60 discovery through its original SF61 consumer. Preserves pagination, opaque search cursors, source URL and observation time. The buyer explorer exports that exact page for original SF88 preparation.',
      { tenant, ...page }, ['tenant'], { readOnly: true, idempotent: true }),
  ];
}

function fleetDeliveryTools(tool) {
  const scope = { tenant, slot: alias }, selected = { ...scope, id: release };
  const destination = { type: 'string', pattern: '^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,47}$' };
  const settings = { type: 'object', additionalProperties: false, properties: {
    id: destination, label: { type: 'string', minLength: 1, maxLength: 100 },
    url: { type: 'string', minLength: 1, maxLength: 4096 },
    allowedHost: { type: 'string', minLength: 1, maxLength: 253 },
    secretEnv: { type: 'string', pattern: '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{1,64}$' },
    routeIds: { type: 'array', maxItems: 100, uniqueItems: true,
      items: { type: 'string', pattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,80}$' } },
    networks: { type: 'array', maxItems: 32, uniqueItems: true,
      items: { type: 'string', pattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,32}:[A-Za-z0-9:_-]{1,100}$' } },
    history: { type: 'string', enum: ['all', 'new'] }, paused: { type: 'boolean' },
    expectedRevision: revision, eventId: digest, expectedDeliveryRevision: digest,
    limit: { type: 'integer', minimum: 1, maximum: 100 },
    concurrency: { type: 'integer', minimum: 1, maximum: 16 },
    destinationConcurrency: { type: 'integer', minimum: 1, maximum: 16 },
    timeoutMs: { type: 'integer', minimum: 100, maximum: 60000 },
    pollMs: { type: 'integer', minimum: 100, maximum: 60000 },
  } };
  return [
    tool('merchant_fleet_delivery_status', 'Read this release store’s actual original settlement producer, journal warning, source receipt count, destination cursors, original delivery leases and worker state. The fleet must be owned here; the selected slot may be stopped.',
      scope, ['tenant', 'slot'], { readOnly: true, idempotent: true }),
    tool('merchant_fleet_delivery_control', 'Operate the original SF98 destination workspace for this tenant and slot. Actions: enroll (id,label,url,allowedHost,secretEnv,history; optional routeIds/networks), pause (id,paused,expectedRevision), sync/drain (optional id), start/stop, requeue (id,eventId,expectedRevision,expectedDeliveryRevision). Worker settings retain original bounds. HTTPS destination signing uses the named environment reference in this host process.',
      { ...scope, action: { type: 'string', enum: ['enroll', 'pause', 'sync', 'drain', 'start', 'stop', 'requeue'] }, input: settings },
      ['tenant', 'slot', 'action', 'input'], { openWorld: true }),
    tool('merchant_fleet_delivery_events', 'Read an original destination’s receipt IDs, settlement payloads, delivery outcomes and exact maintenance revisions, with its original pagination and filters.',
      { ...scope, id: destination, state: { type: 'string', enum: ['ALL', 'PENDING', 'DELIVERED', 'RETRY', 'REQUEUE', 'EXHAUSTED'] },
        offset: { type: 'integer', minimum: 0 }, limit: { type: 'integer', minimum: 1, maximum: 200 } },
      ['tenant', 'slot', 'id'], { readOnly: true, idempotent: true }),
    tool('merchant_fleet_delivery_transfers', 'List named immutable original SF98 destination exchanges for this store. Each keeps the source journal, destination descriptors, cursors and delivery history, and remains readable independently of the live source.',
      { ...scope, after: release, limit: { type: 'integer', minimum: 1, maximum: 50 } },
      ['tenant', 'slot'], { readOnly: true, idempotent: true }),
    tool('merchant_fleet_delivery_transfer', 'Create or reopen a named original SF98 portable exchange using the source fingerprint from delivery status. Original source and destination continuity is verified before publication. An existing ID reopens its retained capture; use a new ID to capture later history.',
      { ...selected, expectedSourceFingerprint: digest }, ['tenant', 'slot', 'id', 'expectedSourceFingerprint'], { idempotent: true }),
    tool('merchant_fleet_delivery_manifest', 'Inspect a named original destination exchange and its exact native file names, bytes and SHA-256 values. Returns the existing destinations CLI inspection and receiving arguments; receiving preserves original delivery history and cursors.',
      { ...selected, expectedFingerprint: digest }, ['tenant', 'slot', 'id'], { readOnly: true, idempotent: true }),
    tool('merchant_fleet_delivery_file', 'Read original SF98 exchange bytes through the existing retained-file reader. Supply the inspected exchange fingerprint, relative member name and SHA-256; continue with readId and offset. Private path selection stays in the native store.',
      { ...selected, expectedFingerprint: digest, expectedSha256: digest,
        name: { type: 'string', pattern: '^(?:manifest\\.json|source/(?:manifest\\.json|events\\.ndjson|deliveries\\.ndjson)|destinations/[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,47}/(?:manifest\\.json|events\\.ndjson|deliveries\\.ndjson))$' },
        readId: identity, offset: { type: 'integer', minimum: 0 },
        limit: { type: 'integer', minimum: 1, maximum: MAX_RETAINED_CHUNK_BYTES } },
      ['tenant', 'slot', 'id', 'expectedFingerprint', 'expectedSha256', 'name'], { readOnly: true, idempotent: true }),
    tool('merchant_fleet_delivery_file_release', 'Release only this store and transfer’s temporary verified file read. Original exchange files remain retained for subsequent receiving or resume.',
      { ...selected, readId: identity }, ['tenant', 'slot', 'id', 'readId'], { readOnly: true, idempotent: true }),
  ];
}

function fleetControlTools(tool) {
  return [
    ...fleetClientTools(tool),
    ...fleetDiscoveryTools(tool),
    ...fleetDeliveryTools(tool),
    tool('merchant_fleet_plan', 'Inspect the host-configured original fleet: plan digest, tenant/slot/package aliases, listener ports and limits. Reads original release stores without starting a process or exposing private paths.', {}, [], { readOnly: true, idempotent: true }),
    tool('merchant_fleet_status', 'Read this MCP process ownership and the original live fleet revision, candidates, exact release mapping, retained rollback history, active requests and drain state. A stopped fleet remains stopped.', {}, [], { readOnly: true, idempotent: true }),
    tool('merchant_fleet_start', 'Start or reopen the original retained multi-store fleet using the exact inspected host-plan digest. Starts its original selected merchant sessions and gateway; does not request a paid resource.', { expectedPlanDigest: digest }, ['expectedPlanDigest'], { openWorld: true }),
    tool('merchant_fleet_catalog', 'Inspect the retained original release catalog and selection generation for one declared tenant/slot. Requires this process to own the running fleet.', { tenant, slot: alias }, ['tenant', 'slot'], { readOnly: true, idempotent: true }),
    tool('merchant_fleet_stage', 'Stage one host-registered merchant source through its original release engine into a new immutable release in the selected tenant/slot. Uses the configured source kind and capture limits; returns its actual digest and native source facts without routing traffic to it.', { tenant, slot: alias, package: alias, releaseId: release }, ['tenant', 'slot', 'package', 'releaseId']),
    tool('merchant_fleet_review', 'Compare a staged replacement against the currently serving tenant release. Returns exact native changes and a short-lived review bound to the fleet revision and original store generations.', { tenant, slot: alias, releaseId: release }, ['tenant', 'slot', 'releaseId']),
    tool('merchant_fleet_prepare', 'Consume an original replacement review, start its selected merchant session and prepare the native fleet candidate. Returns the candidate ID and exact expected revision for activation.', { reviewId: identity }, ['reviewId'], { openWorld: true }),
    tool('merchant_fleet_activate', 'Activate the exact prepared candidate at its reviewed fleet revision. Existing requests drain on the prior original merchant sessions; new requests use the activated release.', { candidateId: identity, expectedRevision: revision }, ['candidateId', 'expectedRevision']),
    tool('merchant_fleet_rollback_review', 'Review a specific retained original fleet revision, comparing all affected tenant releases and verifying their native immutable source identities.', { targetRevision: revision }, ['targetRevision']),
    tool('merchant_fleet_rollback', 'Consume the original rollback review, reopen any needed retained merchant sessions and restore that exact fleet mapping as a new native revision.', { reviewId: identity }, ['reviewId'], { openWorld: true }),
    tool('merchant_fleet_retire', 'Retire only the named original child instance owned by this fleet after it has no current/candidate routing or draining requests. The original gateway routing mutex spans the child close.', { tenant, slot: alias, instanceId: identity, expectedRevision: revision }, ['tenant', 'slot', 'instanceId', 'expectedRevision'], { destructive: true }),
    tool('merchant_fleet_operations', 'Read the original developer explorer and available merchant operations or private availability desk links for the exact running instance owned by this fleet. Use tenant, slot and instanceId from merchant_fleet_status. Keep the availability control link in the operator session.', { tenant, slot: alias, instanceId: identity }, ['tenant', 'slot', 'instanceId'], { readOnly: true, idempotent: true }),
    tool('merchant_fleet_stop', 'Gracefully drain the original gateway and close its owned merchant sessions. Pass managerId from merchant_fleet_status. Preserves native release, mapping and rollback state.', { managerId: identity }, ['managerId'], { destructive: true }),
    tool('merchant_fleet_restart', 'Drain this process-owned fleet, then reopen its retained original state with the inspected host-plan digest. Checks current manager ownership and plan before stopping.', { managerId: identity, expectedPlanDigest: digest }, ['managerId', 'expectedPlanDigest'], { destructive: true, openWorld: true }),
  ];
}

export { fleetControlTools, fleetClientTools, fleetDiscoveryTools, digest, tenant, alias, release, identity, revision };

import { graphqlFileTools } from './graphql-workspace-files.mjs';

const aliasSchema = { type: 'string', pattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,63}$' };

const projectSchema = { type: 'string', pattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,63}$' };

const uuidSchema = { type: 'string', pattern: '^[a-f0-9]{8}-[a-f0-9]{4}-4[a-f0-9]{3}-[89ab][a-f0-9]{3}-[a-f0-9]{12}$' };

const shaSchema = { type: 'string', pattern: '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' };

const revisionSchema = { type: 'integer', minimum: 1 };

const generationSchema = { type: 'integer', minimum: 0 };

const rangeSchema = { offset: { type: 'integer', minimum: 0 }, limit: { type: 'integer', minimum: 1, maximum: 50 },
  expectedSnapshotSha256: shaSchema };

const operationSchema = { type: 'string', pattern: '^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,63}$' };

const common = { workspace: aliasSchema, project: projectSchema };

const current = { ...common, expectedRevision: revisionSchema };

const deployment = { ...current, deploymentId: uuidSchema };

const textSchema = { type: 'string', minLength: 1, maxLength: 240 };

function graphqlWorkspaceTools(tool) {
  const read = { readOnly: true, idempotent: true };
  return [
    tool('merchant_graphql_status', 'List host-declared original GraphQL workspaces/source aliases or inspect one open workspace and its native runtime. Browser URLs are private operator capabilities.',
      { workspace: aliasSchema }, [], read),
    tool('merchant_graphql_open', 'Open the original GraphQL workspace server and its single kernel-owned writer. Browser and MCP share that same project, preview and release state.',
      { workspace: aliasSchema }, ['workspace'], { idempotent: true }),
    tool('merchant_graphql_close', 'Cancel and drain this owned workspace connection, previews and native release consoles; preserve every saved project/result and original file.',
      { workspace: aliasSchema, instanceId: uuidSchema }, ['workspace', 'instanceId'], { idempotent: true }),
    tool('merchant_graphql_projects', 'Page original saved projects. Repeat expectedSnapshotSha256 when paging a changing list.',
      { workspace: aliasSchema, ...rangeSchema }, ['workspace'], read),
    tool('merchant_graphql_project', 'Inspect an exact saved project revision, optional full raw draft, or a page of its original merchant exports/deployments/previews. Raw unfinished drafts remain available.',
      { ...common, revision: revisionSchema, includeInput: { type: 'boolean' },
        collection: { enum: ['exports', 'deployments', 'previews'] }, ...rangeSchema }, ['workspace', 'project'], read),
    tool('merchant_graphql_history', 'Read the original most-recent 100-revision history window with its native more flag. Open any older retained revision explicitly with merchant_graphql_project.',
      { ...common, ...rangeSchema }, ['workspace', 'project'], read),
    tool('merchant_graphql_schema', 'Page actual captured/supplied schema roots, types, or a selected type’s fields and enum values from an immutable saved revision. The original GraphQL reference compiler validates the source.',
      { ...common, revision: revisionSchema, collection: { enum: ['roots', 'types'] }, type: operationSchema, ...rangeSchema },
      ['workspace', 'project', 'revision'], read),
    tool('merchant_graphql_capture', 'Make one deliberate original introspection request to a host-declared source. Optionally save that exact schema into the selected project at its expected revision; includeSchema controls the full text in the reply. Existing queries, plan and title remain intact.',
      { workspace: aliasSchema, source: aliasSchema, project: projectSchema, expectedRevision: revisionSchema,
        includeSchema: { type: 'boolean' } }, ['workspace', 'source'], { openWorld: true }),
    tool('merchant_graphql_operation', 'Open an existing fixed query as the original field/argument/bounded-variable model, or compile a proposed model without saving. Use merchant_graphql_schema for paged field discovery.',
      { ...common, revision: revisionSchema, operation: operationSchema, model: { type: 'object', additionalProperties: true } },
      ['workspace', 'project', 'revision', 'operation'], read),
    tool('merchant_graphql_apply_operation', 'Compile one original field selection, then atomically save its query and matching plan route name/samples at the expected revision. Keeps price, payment and public-path fields; an invalid raw plan stays intact for repair.',
      { ...current, operation: operationSchema, model: { type: 'object', additionalProperties: true } },
      ['workspace', 'project', 'expectedRevision', 'operation', 'model']),
    tool('merchant_graphql_save', 'Save raw draft field changes through the original immutable revision/CAS store. For a new project use expectedRevision 0 and all four fields; unfinished raw query/plan text is preserved.',
      { ...common, expectedRevision: generationSchema, input: { type: 'object', properties: {
        title: { type: 'string', maxLength: 160 }, schemaText: { type: 'string', maxLength: 1048576 },
        queriesText: { type: 'string', maxLength: 1048576 }, planText: { type: 'string', maxLength: 262144 } }, additionalProperties: false } },
      ['workspace', 'project', 'expectedRevision', 'input']),
    tool('merchant_graphql_review', 'Validate a saved schema/query/merchant plan with the original compiler and inspect its actual routes, variables and payment terms. No source request or seller start.',
      { ...common, revision: revisionSchema }, ['workspace', 'project', 'revision'], read),
    tool('merchant_graphql_preview_start', 'Start one original read-only GraphQL operation against the saved project with a retained preview UUID. Returns immediately; status/result/recover use that same native record, and a started unknown request is never resent automatically.',
      { ...current, source: aliasSchema, previewId: uuidSchema, operation: operationSchema,
        variables: { type: 'object', additionalProperties: true } },
      ['workspace', 'project', 'expectedRevision', 'source', 'previewId', 'operation', 'variables'], { idempotent: true, openWorld: true }),
    tool('merchant_graphql_preview_status', 'Inspect or page original completed/started preview records, their request/response identities and attachment state. Does not repeat a source request.',
      { ...common, previewId: uuidSchema, ...rangeSchema }, ['workspace', 'project'], read),
    tool('merchant_graphql_preview_cancel', 'Request cancellation only of this process-owned preview transport. The original handler retains any returned or cancelled outcome; inspect its same native record afterward.',
      { ...common, previewId: uuidSchema }, ['workspace', 'project', 'previewId'], { idempotent: true }),
    tool('merchant_graphql_preview_recover', 'Attach an already completed native preview to the current project without another provider request. Its original source revision/digest remain explicit even after later draft edits.',
      { ...current, previewId: uuidSchema }, ['workspace', 'project', 'expectedRevision', 'previewId'], { idempotent: true }),
    tool('merchant_graphql_preview_result', 'Page a selected JSON pointer in the actual retained response, preserving the exact response hash. Download original response bytes with the retained-file tools; this structured view never reruns the query.',
      { ...common, previewId: uuidSchema, pointer: { type: 'string', maxLength: 2048 }, ...rangeSchema },
      ['workspace', 'project', 'previewId'], read),
    tool('merchant_graphql_prepare', 'Prepare the original complete merchant and generated buyer package from the current reviewed saved project. On a lost reply inspect project/history before another preparation.',
      { ...current, source: aliasSchema }, ['workspace', 'project', 'expectedRevision', 'source']),
    tool('merchant_graphql_evolution', 'Compare a saved candidate with its retained baseline merchant or read an already prepared original revision report. Comparison returns the exact digest required by prepare_revision.',
      { ...current, baselineExportId: uuidSchema, reportExportId: uuidSchema },
      ['workspace', 'project', 'expectedRevision'], read),
    tool('merchant_graphql_prepare_revision', 'Prepare the original revised merchant, exact baseline copy and buyer handoff using the current saved draft and inspected comparison digest.',
      { ...current, source: aliasSchema, baselineExportId: uuidSchema, comparisonDigest: shaSchema },
      ['workspace', 'project', 'expectedRevision', 'source', 'baselineExportId', 'comparisonDigest']),
    tool('merchant_graphql_deployment', 'Prepare or continue the original deployment: prepare a merchant export, stage a native release with host runtime settings, generate a host-declared installation packet, or recover its finished attachment.',
      { ...current, action: { enum: ['prepare', 'stage', 'host', 'recover'] }, source: aliasSchema,
        exportId: uuidSchema, deploymentId: uuidSchema, releaseId: aliasSchema, label: textSchema, host: aliasSchema },
      ['workspace', 'project', 'expectedRevision', 'action']),
    tool('merchant_graphql_deployment_status', 'Inspect the original deployment generation, source identity, staged release, host readiness and any finished unattached continuation.',
      { ...common, deploymentId: uuidSchema }, ['workspace', 'project', 'deploymentId'], read),
    tool('merchant_graphql_release_status', 'Inspect the original project release console or compare two retained native releases. Browser handover uses that same console and seller owner.',
      { ...deployment, to: aliasSchema, from: aliasSchema }, ['workspace', 'project', 'expectedRevision', 'deploymentId'], read),
    tool('merchant_graphql_release_change', 'Activate, roll back, start, stop or restart through the original release console. Changes bind the inspected immutable digest/current generation; stop/restart require that console’s exact instance ID.',
      { ...deployment, action: { enum: ['activate', 'rollback', 'start', 'stop', 'restart'] },
        releaseId: aliasSchema, expectedDigest: shaSchema, expectedGeneration: generationSchema,
        reason: textSchema, instanceId: { type: 'string', minLength: 1, maxLength: 64 } },
      ['workspace', 'project', 'expectedRevision', 'deploymentId', 'action']),
    ...graphqlFileTools(tool),
  ];
}

export { graphqlWorkspaceTools, aliasSchema, uuidSchema, rangeSchema, common, revisionSchema, operationSchema, projectSchema, current, generationSchema, shaSchema, textSchema, deployment };

class ProofError(ValueError):
    pass


def need(condition, code):
    if not condition:
        raise ProofError(code)


def absolute(value):
    need(isinstance(value, str) and value.startswith("/") and "\0" not in value,
         "ABSOLUTE_ORIGINAL_PATH_REQUIRED")
    path = Path(value).resolve(strict=True)
    need(str(path) == value, "ORIGINAL_CANONICAL_PATH_REQUIRED")
    return path


def contained(path, root):
    return path == root or root in path.parents


def stable_bytes(path, expected=None, limit=MAX_FILE):
    if expected is not None:
        need(isinstance(expected, str) and SHA.fullmatch(expected), "EXACT_SOURCE_SHA256_REQUIRED")
    descriptor = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_CLOEXEC | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    with os.fdopen(descriptor, "rb") as stream:
        before = os.fstat(stream.fileno())
        need(stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and before.st_size <= limit,
             "BOUNDED_REGULAR_SOURCE_REQUIRED")
        raw = stream.read(limit + 1)
        after = os.fstat(stream.fileno())
    identity = lambda value: (value.st_dev, value.st_ino, value.st_size,
                              value.st_mtime_ns, value.st_ctime_ns)
    need(identity(before) == identity(after) and len(raw) == before.st_size,
         "SOURCE_CHANGED_DURING_READ")
    digest = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
    need(expected is None or digest == expected, "ORIGINAL_SOURCE_SHA256_MISMATCH")
    return raw, {"path": str(path), "sha256": digest, "bytes": len(raw),
                 "device": before.st_dev, "inode": before.st_ino}


def parse(raw):
    value = json.loads(raw)
    need(isinstance(value, dict), "JSON_OBJECT_REQUIRED")
    return value


def instant(value):
    need(isinstance(value, str), "ORIGINAL_TIMESTAMP_REQUIRED")
    parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(value.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
    need(parsed.tzinfo is not None, "ORIGINAL_TIMESTAMP_ZONE_REQUIRED")
    return parsed


def confirm_bindings(bindings):
    for binding in bindings.values():
        _, current = stable_bytes(Path(binding["path"]), binding["sha256"])
        need(current == binding, "ORIGINAL_SOURCE_IDENTITY_CHANGED")


def proc_status(path):
    raw = (path / "stat").read_text()
    fields = raw[raw.rfind(")") + 2:].split()
    need(len(fields) >= 20, "PROCFS_STAT_INCOMPLETE")
    nspids = None
    for line in (path / "status").read_text().splitlines():
        if line.startswith("NSpid:"):
            nspids = [int(value) for value in line.partition(":")[2].split()]
    need(nspids and nspids[0] == int(raw.partition(" ")[0]),
         "PROCFS_NAMESPACE_VISIBILITY_REQUIRED")
    return {"proc_pid": nspids[0], "pid": nspids[-1], "nspids": nspids,
            "start_ticks": fields[19], "state": fields[0]}


def process_absent(identity, boot_id):
    need(isinstance(identity, dict) and type(identity.get("proc_pid")) is int and
         identity["proc_pid"] > 0 and type(identity.get("pid")) is int and identity["pid"] > 0 and
         isinstance(identity.get("start_ticks"), str) and identity["start_ticks"].isdecimal() and
         isinstance(identity.get("boot_id"), str) and
         isinstance(identity.get("namespace"), str) and
         re.fullmatch(r"pid:\[\d+\]", identity["namespace"]), "ORIGINAL_KERNEL_IDENTITY_REQUIRED")
    if identity["boot_id"] != boot_id:
        return {"outcome": "ORIGINAL_BOOT_ENDED"}
    try:
        current = proc_status(Path("/proc") / str(identity["proc_pid"]))
    except (FileNotFoundError, ProcessLookupError):
        return {"outcome": "ORIGINAL_PROCFS_ENTRY_ABSENT"}
    if current["state"] in ("Z", "X"):
        return {"outcome": "ORIGINAL_PROCESS_EXITED", "observed": current}
    if current["start_ticks"] != identity["start_ticks"]:
        return {"outcome": "PROCFS_PID_REUSED", "observed": current}
    # Missing permission to follow a namespace link cannot make a matching
    # live kernel lifetime look absent. Boot, procfs PID and start already bind it.
    raise ProofError("ORIGINAL_NATIVE_PROCESS_STILL_ALIVE")


def legacy_pid_absent(pid, namespace, boot_id, original_boot):
    if boot_id != original_boot:
        return {"outcome": "ORIGINAL_BOOT_ENDED", "observedProcesses": 0}
    current = proc_status(Path("/proc/self"))
    root = proc_status(Path("/proc/1"))
    need(current["pid"] == os.getpid() and root["nspids"] == [1],
         "COMPLETE_PROCFS_SCOPE_REQUIRED")
    mounts = []
    for line in Path("/proc/self/mountinfo").read_text().splitlines():
        before, separator, after = line.partition(" - ")
        if separator and before.split()[4] == "/proc" and after.split()[0] == "proc":
            mounts.append(before.split()[5].split(",") + after.split()[2].split(","))
    need(len(mounts) == 1 and not any(option.startswith("hidepid=") and
         option not in ("hidepid=0", "hidepid=off") for option in mounts[0]),
         "UNHIDDEN_PROCFS_SCOPE_REQUIRED")
    observed = unrelated = 0
    for path in Path("/proc").iterdir():
        if not path.name.isdecimal():
            continue
        try:
            item = proc_status(path)
            if item["state"] in ("Z", "X"):
                continue
            observed += 1
            if item["pid"] != pid:
                continue
            actual_namespace = os.readlink(path / "ns/pid")
            confirmed = proc_status(path)
            need(confirmed["start_ticks"] == item["start_ticks"], "PROCFS_CANDIDATE_CHANGED_REINSPECT")
            if confirmed["state"] in ("Z", "X"):
                continue
            need(actual_namespace != namespace, "ORIGINAL_ATTEMPT_PROCESS_STILL_ALIVE")
            unrelated += 1
        except (FileNotFoundError, ProcessLookupError):
            continue
    return {"outcome": "LEGACY_PID_ABSENT_FROM_ORIGINAL_NAMESPACE", "legacyPid": pid,
            "originalNamespace": namespace, "observedProcesses": observed,
            "otherNamespacePidMatches": unrelated, "observer": current,
            "observerNamespace": os.readlink("/proc/self/ns/pid"), "mountOptions": mounts[0]}

def existing_record_lock(root):
    descriptor = os.open(root / ".lock", os.O_RDONLY | os.O_CLOEXEC | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    with os.fdopen(descriptor, "rb") as stream:

    identity = attempt.get("processIdentity")
    need(isinstance(identity, dict) and identity.get("schema") == IDENTITY_SCHEMA and
         identity.get("status") == "RECORDED" and identity.get("pid") == attempt.get("pid"),
         "ORIGINAL_RECORDED_IDENTITY_REQUIRED")
    if "processIdentity" in selected:
        need(selected["processIdentity"] == identity, "RECORDED_IDENTITY_INPUT_DIFFERS")
    parent = identity.get("parent")
    need(isinstance(parent, dict) and type(parent.get("procPid")) is int and parent["procPid"] > 0 and
         parent["procPid"] != identity.get("procPid") and isinstance(parent.get("startTicks"), str) and
         parent["startTicks"].isdecimal() and parent.get("namespace") == identity.get("namespace"),
         "ORIGINAL_RECORDED_PARENT_BINDING_REQUIRED")
    original = {"pid": identity.get("pid"), "proc_pid": identity.get("procPid"),
                "start_ticks": identity.get("startTicks"), "namespace": identity.get("namespace"),
                "boot_id": identity.get("bootId")}
    boot = Path("/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id").read_text().strip()
    # procPid belongs to the PID namespace represented by the original procfs
    # superblock. A different isolated /proc can hide a still-live host PID.
    # A changed boot conclusively ends the old lifetime; a same-boot observation
    # must use that same procfs superblock before treating ENOENT as absence.
    if original["boot_id"] == boot:
        need(isinstance(identity.get("procfsDevice"), str) and identity["procfsDevice"].isdecimal() and
             identity["procfsDevice"] == str(Path("/proc").stat().st_dev),
             "ORIGINAL_PROCFS_SCOPE_REQUIRED")
    # The application parent may still be alive after its child failed. Retain
    # its captured identity; the Governor owns the separate approval writer lock.
    observed = process_absent(original, boot)
    confirm_bindings(bindings)
    process_absent(original, boot)
    need(Path("/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id").read_text().strip() == boot, "KERNEL_BOOT_CHANGED")
    result = result_base(intent_id, config_sha, bindings, directory, workspace)
    result.update(nativeRecord=None, procfs={"bootId": boot, "attempt": observed,
                                            "processIdentity": identity})
    return result


def compact_json(value):
    # Source bindings contain JSON objects with ASCII field names and integral
    # byte counts. This matches the runtime's recursively sorted JSON encoding.
    return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True,

    need(isinstance(command, list) and len(command) in (4, 9) and
         all(isinstance(arg, str) and "\0" not in arg and len(arg) <= 16384 for arg in command) and
         Path(command[0]).is_absolute() and Path(command[1]).is_absolute(),
         "ORIGINAL_NATIVE_START_COMMAND_REQUIRED")
    ticket = operation.get("ticketSha256")
    need(ticket is None or isinstance(ticket, str) and SHA.fullmatch(ticket),
         "ORIGINAL_NATIVE_START_TICKET_INVALID")
    expected_args = ["execute-workspace", "--dir", str(workspace), "--config",
                     bindings["config"]["path"], "--ticket-sha", ticket or "none"]
    if len(command) == 9:
        need(command[2:] == expected_args, "ORIGINAL_NATIVE_START_COMMAND_BINDINGS_DIFFER")
    # store.mjs jsonBytes uses JSON.stringify(value, null, 2) plus one newline.
    # The argv consists only of strings, so this reproduces those exact bytes.
    encoded = (json.dumps(command, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n").encode("utf-8")
    need(isinstance(receipt.get("commandSha256"), str) and SHA.fullmatch(receipt["commandSha256"]) and
         hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest() == receipt["commandSha256"],
         "ORIGINAL_NATIVE_START_COMMAND_SHA256_DIFFERS")
    if len(command) == 4:
        reserved_start_command(command, operation, bindings, expected_args)
    # A settled runtime return before any spawn event is retained atomically in
    # this same pinned attempt. A missing receipt never implies no child.
    confirm_bindings(bindings)
    result = result_base(intent_id, config_sha, bindings, directory, workspace)
    result.update(nativeRecord=None, nativeStart=receipt,
                  procfs={"attempt": {"outcome": "ORIGINAL_NATIVE_PROCESS_NOT_DISPATCHED"}})
    return result


def inspect_request(request_path):
    request_raw, request_binding = stable_bytes(absolute(request_path))
    selected = parse(request_raw)
    need(selected.get("schema") == REQUEST_SCHEMA, "PROCESS_PROOF_REQUEST_SCHEMA_REQUIRED")
    intent_id = selected.get("intentId")
    need(isinstance(intent_id, str) and 0 < len(intent_id) <= 512, "ORIGINAL_INTENT_REQUIRED")
    directory = absolute(selected["operationDirectory"])
    need(directory.name == hashlib.sha256(intent_id.encode()).hexdigest(), "ORIGINAL_OPERATION_DIRECTORY_MISMATCH")
    workspace = absolute(selected["nativeWorkspace"])
    bindings = {"proofRequest": request_binding}
    documents = {}
    attempt_directory = None
    for name in ("operation", "config", "review", "attempt"):
        path = absolute(selected[name + "Path"])
        at_root = path == directory / (name + ".json")
        in_history = (name in ("review", "attempt") and path.name == name + ".json" and
                      path.parent.parent == directory / "preapproval-history" and
                      SHA.fullmatch(path.parent.name))
        need(at_root or in_history, "ORIGINAL_OPERATION_MEMBER_REQUIRED")
        if name in ("review", "attempt"):
            need(attempt_directory is None or path.parent == attempt_directory,
                 "ORIGINAL_ATTEMPT_REVIEW_DIRECTORY_DIFFERS")
            attempt_directory = path.parent
        raw, bindings[name] = stable_bytes(path, selected["expected"][name + "Sha256"],
                                            limit=ATTEMPT_LIMIT if name == "attempt" else MAX_FILE)
        documents[name] = parse(raw)
    operation, config, review, attempt = (documents[name] for name in ("operation", "config", "review", "attempt"))
    config_sha = bindings["config"]["sha256"]
    need(operation.get("schema") == "stellar-forge.node-buyer.v1" and operation.get("state") == "PREPARED" and
         all(value.get("intentId") == intent_id for value in (operation, config.get("operation", {}), review, attempt)) and
         all(value.get("configSha256") == config_sha for value in (operation, review, attempt)),
         "ORIGINAL_OPERATION_BINDINGS_DIFFER")
    need(operation.get("nativeWorkspace") == str(workspace) == review.get("nativeWorkspace") and
         review.get("native", {}).get("mode") == "OFFLINE_REVIEW" and
         review["native"].get("intentId") == intent_id and
         all(value.get("bodySha256") == operation.get("bodySha256") for value in (review, attempt)),
         "ORIGINAL_REVIEW_BINDINGS_DIFFER")
    need(instant(operation["createdAt"]) <= instant(attempt["startedAt"]), "ORIGINAL_ATTEMPT_ORDER_DIFFERS")
    need(config.get("operator", {}).get("ledger") == str(workspace / "reservations.sqlite") and
         config["operator"].get("policy") == str(workspace / "policy.json") and
         config.get("signerModule") == str(workspace / "signer.mjs"), "ORIGINAL_NATIVE_WORKSPACE_BINDINGS_DIFFER")

    if attempt.get("state") == "NOT_DISPATCHED":
        return not_dispatched_proof(attempt, operation, bindings, directory, workspace, intent_id, config_sha)
    need(attempt.get("state") in ("STARTED", "INTERRUPTED_OR_START_FAILED", "NATIVE_RESULT_UNAVAILABLE") and
         type(attempt.get("pid")) is int and attempt["pid"] > 0, "ORIGINAL_STARTED_ATTEMPT_REQUIRED")

    if isinstance(attempt.get("processIdentity"), dict) and attempt["processIdentity"].get("status") == "RECORDED":
        return recorded_identity_proof(selected, attempt, bindings, directory, workspace, intent_id, config_sha)

    selection = selected["nativeRecord"]
    root = absolute(selection["directory"])
    host = absolute(selection["hostRoot"])
    with existing_record_lock(root) as record_lock:
        retained = {}
        for name, filename, key in (("nativeRequest", "request.json", "requestSha256"),
                                    ("nativeProcess", "process.json", "processSha256"),
                                    ("nativeOutput", "output.log", "outputSha256")):
            raw, bindings[name] = stable_bytes(root / filename, selection[key])
            retained[name] = raw
        native_request, process = parse(retained["nativeRequest"]), parse(retained["nativeProcess"])
        intent = native_request.get("intent", {})
        operation_id = selection["operationId"]
        need(native_request.get("schema") == "commons.native_cloud_command/v1" and
             intent.get("operation_id") == operation_id and
             root.name == hashlib.sha256(operation_id.encode()).hexdigest(), "ORIGINAL_NATIVE_RECORD_MISMATCH")
        command = selection["command"]
        need(isinstance(command, list) and command == intent.get("command") and
             all(isinstance(arg, str) and "\0" not in arg for arg in command), "ORIGINAL_NATIVE_COMMAND_MISMATCH")
        driver = absolute(selection["driverPath"])
        _, bindings["driver"] = stable_bytes(driver, selection["driverSha256"])
        need(command.count(str(driver)) == 1 and str(driver) in intent.get("runtime_paths", []),
             "ORIGINAL_DRIVER_DECLARATION_MISMATCH")
        disk_paths = [Path(row["path"]) for row in intent.get("disk", {}).get("paths", [])]
        need(any(contained(directory, path) and contained(workspace, path) for path in disk_paths),
             "ORIGINAL_WORKSPACE_NOT_IN_NATIVE_REQUEST")
        log = [parse(line) for line in retained["nativeOutput"].splitlines() if line.strip()]
        reviews = [i for i, line in enumerate(log) if line.get("phase") == "original-workspace-and-node-review" and
                   line.get("intentId") == intent_id and line.get("configSha256") == config_sha]
        approvals = [i for i, line in enumerate(log) if line.get("phase") == "original-native-approval-next" and
                     line.get("intentId") == intent_id]
        need(len(reviews) == len(approvals) == 1 and reviews[0] < approvals[0] == len(log) - 1,
             "ORIGINAL_NATIVE_APPROVAL_BOUNDARY_DIFFERS")
        terms = config["operation"]["expect"]
        need(log[approvals[0]].get("network") == terms["network"] and
             log[approvals[0]].get("amountAtomic") == terms["maxAtomic"] and
             log[approvals[0]].get("asset") == terms["asset"], "ORIGINAL_NATIVE_APPROVAL_TERMS_DIFFER")
        raw, bindings["nativeState"] = stable_bytes(root / "state.json")
        state = parse(raw)
        need(state.get("process") == process and isinstance(state.get("supervisor"), dict) and
             state["supervisor"].get("namespace") == process.get("namespace") and
             state["supervisor"].get("boot_id") == process.get("boot_id") and
             instant(native_request["created_at"]) <= instant(operation["createdAt"]),
             "ORIGINAL_NATIVE_PROCESS_BINDINGS_DIFFER")
        _, bindings["nativeEntry"] = stable_bytes(host / "swarm_cloud_job.py")
        _, bindings["nativeLoader"] = stable_bytes(host / "native_foreground.py")
        sys.path.insert(0, str(host))
        loader = importlib.import_module("native_foreground")
        need(Path(loader.__file__).resolve() == host / "native_foreground.py", "ORIGINAL_NATIVE_LOADER_REQUIRED")
        native = loader.load_native(host)
        # The installed inspector owns any observation locks. Release our short
        # metadata guard before calling it, then recheck every hash and inode.
        fcntl.flock(record_lock.fileno(), fcntl.LOCK_UN)
        observation = native.inspect(root, capacity=False)
        need(observation.get("operation_id") == operation_id and observation.get("state") == "interrupted" and
             observation.get("supervisor_alive") is False and observation.get("process_alive") is False,
             "ORIGINAL_NATIVE_OPERATION_NOT_INTERRUPTED")
        boot = Path("/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id").read_text().strip()
        parent_observation = process_absent(state["supervisor"], boot)
        process_observation = process_absent(process, boot)
        attempt_observation = legacy_pid_absent(attempt["pid"], process["namespace"], boot, process["boot_id"])
        process_absent(state["supervisor"], boot)
        process_absent(process, boot)
        confirm_bindings(bindings)
        need(Path("/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id").read_text().strip() == boot, "KERNEL_BOOT_CHANGED")
    result = result_base(intent_id, config_sha, bindings, directory, workspace)
    result.update(nativeRecord={"directory": str(root), "hostRoot": str(host),
                  "operationId": operation_id, "command": command, "state": observation["state"],
                  "supervisorAlive": False, "processAlive": False,
                  "supervisor": state["supervisor"], "process": process,
                  "supervisorObservation": parent_observation, "processObservation": process_observation},
                  procfs={"bootId": boot, "attempt": attempt_observation})
    return result


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--request", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    try:
        print(json.dumps(inspect_request(args.request), separators=(",", ":")))
        return 0
    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError, IndexError, ImportError) as error:
        code = str(error) if isinstance(error, ProofError) else "PROCESS_PROOF_" + type(error).__name__.upper()
        print(json.dumps({"schema": SCHEMA, "outcome": "PROCESS_PROOF_UNAVAILABLE", "code": code}))
        return 2


if __name__ == "__main__":

# Citation update review

The Research workspace connects registered Crossref notices to the evidence and findings already saved in a dossier. An operator can review a notice, edit every affected source assessment and finding, save those choices in one revision, and reopen the report from before or after that decision.

## Working in the original browser

1. Open a saved dossier and choose **Update review**. The page lists the retained notice, the DOI it updates, its registered type and date, and the number of selected evidence occurrences and affected findings.
2. Open a notice. Inspect its registered assertions, original metadata record, source edition, and acquisition or source-document bindings. Publisher and Retraction Watch assertions for the same notice remain separately attributed within that notice.
3. Review the evidence under each original question. Selection, classification and notes are editable per occurrence. The same DOI can occur in several questions; the review shows each occurrence and its original edition.
4. Edit affected findings in full. Each finding keeps its original question and can cite the available sources in that question. Choose a disposition and give a reason for every affected finding.
5. Enter the reviewer name, overall decision and reason, then save. Evidence changes, finding text and citations, dispositions, original notice and source bindings, and the decision are committed together.
6. Open the original, reviewed or current report, or download a complete portable dossier. A later report can display the earlier decision alongside any subsequent changes.

Browser drafts save complete text and the original review base in IndexedDB. The page can reopen draft branches and download a draft. Storage failures leave the open edit available and report the failure. A saved dossier revision is the authoritative completed decision.

### Concurrent edits and a lost response

A draft records both its dossier revision and an impact fingerprint. When either changes, refresh the current dossier and explicitly rebase the draft. The comparison shows the original, draft and current values. Nonconflicting changes combine; conflicting edits require a choice. A source or finding removed from the current review remains visible in the comparison so its old draft text can be recovered.

Before the browser sends a save, it durably records the complete request. If the response is interrupted, recover that same request. Its request ID and payload remain fixed. The server returns the original saved review when that exact request already succeeded, even after later dossier edits. The browser retains a completed receipt if another tab subsequently reports uncertainty.

The original listener supports a fixed --port. Keep the same browser origin when reopening browser drafts; the portable dossier carries completed decisions across machines and fresh browser profiles.

## Notice identity and source coverage

A notice is identified by the normalized notice DOI, updated-work DOI and registered update type. The direction comes from the notice record's update-to entries. Each update-to.DOI identifies the work being updated. The original work may also contain an updated-by entry pointing back to its notice.

Distinct publisher and Retraction Watch assertions are retained and sorted canonically for the review fingerprint. Reordering or repeating an otherwise identical assertion leaves the notice version unchanged. Original response bytes preserve their received order. DOI/title/editorial metadata and registered assertion changes produce a new notice version; indexing, deposit timestamps and citation counters remain retained without reopening a review by themselves.

The latest received observation of a notice supplies its displayed version. Earlier observations and source editions remain accessible. An earlier retained relation also remains available if a later imported record omits it.

Acquisition coverage is displayed for every retained Crossref edition. A skipped, failed or partial updates lookup is carried through from the original acquisition. Direct metadata-document imports report the coverage of their retained work and update-list documents. Inspect this coverage when assessing the extent of the review.

The impact fingerprint includes the notice version, selected or finding-cited evidence assessments, and affected finding text and citations. A newly received unselected occurrence by itself leaves the previous decision current. Selecting or citing it makes it part of the next impact assessment.

### Review states

| State | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| PENDING | This retained notice has no saved review. |
| REVIEW_AGAIN | A saved review exists and the current impact fingerprint has changed. |
| REVIEWED | The latest saved decision matches the current impact. |
| FOLLOW_UP | The matching latest decision explicitly requests follow-up. |

The pending filter includes notices needing an initial review, another review or follow-up. Counts show follow-up separately.

## Decisions and finding dispositions

Overall decisions are retain, revise, exclude and follow-up. The operator's evidence and finding edits define the resulting dossier. Selecting an overall label applies no implicit text or citation changes.

Each currently affected finding requires one of:

| Disposition | Required result |
| --- | --- |
| unchanged | The finding text, title and citations remain unchanged in this review. |
| revised | The finding actually changes in this review. |
| citation-removed | The finding changes and retains none of the affected DOI's occurrences. |
| follow-up | The operator records the question to resolve; explicit edits remain available. |

Finding citations stay in the finding's original question. Existing unavailable reference-only handles can remain attached to that finding. Retained source bodies continue to live in the original dossier's content-addressed store.

## HTTP API

The existing authenticated loopback listener exposes:

| Method and path | Result |
| --- | --- |
| GET /api/dossiers/:id/citation-updates | A revision-pinned notice page, counts and coverage. |
| GET /api/dossiers/:id/citation-updates?revision=N&noticeId=ID | Complete notice, evidence, affected findings, citation choices, bindings and immutable review history. |
| POST /api/dossiers/:id/citation-updates/reviews?projection=metadata | One atomic review or recovery of the same completed request. |
| GET /api/dossiers/:id/export?format=html&revision=N | The original report at the selected revision. |

Notice pages accept revision, offset, limit (1–100) and status (all, pending, reviewed). A page after offset zero requires an explicit revision. Report formats are json, json.gz, md and html. Explicit revision exports include that revision in their filename; full portable exports include the complete history through that revision.

A review request has these fields:

~~~json
{
  "requestId": "a-stable-unique-request-id",
  "noticeId": "copy the cu_ identifier from the selected detail",
  "expectedFingerprint": "copy its 64-character fingerprint",
  "expectedRevision": 12,
  "actor": "Reviewer name",
  "decision": "revise",
  "reason": "The recorded notice changes how the selected work supports this finding.",
  "evidenceChanges": [],
  "findingChanges": [],
  "findingDispositions": []
}
~~~

The identifier and fingerprint shown above are descriptions; copy the actual values from the selected detail before sending the request. Every changed evidence record contains occurrenceId, selected, classification and note. A changed finding contains id, title, text and the complete occurrenceIds array. Each finding disposition contains findingId, disposition and reason.

The endpoint accepts up to 16 MiB of UTF-8 JSON. The original dossier revision limit remains 8 MiB, including its retained decision history. The listener advertises citationReviewRequestLimit in its API capabilities. A rejected save leaves the existing revision intact; keep the draft to adjust or export it.

The response is {dossier,review,duplicate}. Review entries include the exact original request and its digest, before/after fingerprints, actor/reason, original and reviewed revision numbers, previous revision digest, original notice/source bindings and complete before/after changes. Reusing an ID with a different request is rejected.

## Portable reopening and reports

The original JSON and streamed portable formats carry every immutable review entry. Before either importer changes its saved dossier, it validates the complete original history and retained source bytes. For each newly appended review, it reconstructs the previous revision's source projections, runs the same review operation with the saved request and timestamp, and compares the complete reconstructed review and resulting dossier state. This checks the notice record, assertion group, source occurrence, source hash, text/citation changes and decision as one operation.

Markdown and HTML reports include notice status, review identity and reasons, original/reviewed revision numbers, before/after finding titles, text and citations, evidence edits, and original notice/source bindings. Historical report exports restrict their displayed history to the selected revision. A report reopened from the corresponding portable dossier reproduces that saved state.

# Citation update review

The **Update review** tab connects registered source updates to the evidence and findings in a saved Research dossier. It opens from retained editions, preserves each original source record, and saves an operator's evidence and finding changes together in one dossier revision.

## Open the working dossier

Start the existing Research dossier workspace and open its complete local address. Choose the saved dossier, then **Update review**. The tab is available when working from retained source data. Its notice list shows the registered notice, the DOI it updates, the selected evidence affected, and the number of affected findings.

Use **All notices**, **Pending and follow up**, or **Reviewed** to select the list. The counts describe the current dossier revision. The lookup-coverage section retains the actual edition's coverage, missing results and source representation.

A notice's registered type and title describe the original source metadata. The reviewer records what that update means for the dossier's findings.

## Read the original source

Open a notice and expand **Original notice assertions and source records**.

Each occurrence remains tied to its original edition and result key. **Inspect original record** opens the maintained source inspector; **Download original result record** saves the exact declared result serialization. **Download original edition** saves the complete retained edition and verifies its original byte count and SHA-256.

The source register distinguishes two input representations:

| Representation | Retained bindings |
| --- | --- |
| Original HTTP captures | Original URL, observed retrieval time, capture identity and role |
| Retained source documents | Original document identity, document metadata hash, source body hash and size, source URL and full transfer provenance |

A source document with an unexposed retrieval time retains the timestamps and transfer details actually supplied in its provenance. Multiple registered assertions remain available with their original source bindings.

## Prepare the complete review

Enter the reviewer, overall decision and reason. Work through every affected evidence occurrence and finding.

For evidence, edit its selection, classification and complete note. For each finding, edit the full title and text, select the original citation occurrences belonging to its research question, and give an explicit disposition and reason.

| Finding disposition | Result required in this review |
| --- | --- |
| Unchanged | Keep the finding's saved text, title and citations |
| Revised | Record an actual change to its text, title or citations |
| Affected citations removed | Remove every affected citation from that finding and retain the explicit reason |
| Follow up | Record the additional review needed, with any current edits kept explicit |

The overall decision records the operator's conclusion. The evidence and finding controls specify the exact content changes.

**Save complete review** submits the entire selection with the current dossier revision and notice fingerprint. The original engine validates every affected finding, applies the selected edits, and records their source bindings in one atomic revision. The saved review retains its original revision, resulting revision, author, reason, full changes and finding dispositions.

## Continue a draft or resolve a concurrent edit

Edits are saved in this browser's IndexedDB with their original base revision. Refreshing the notice or dossier preserves the working draft. Earlier branches remain available in **Other retained draft versions**. **Download draft** saves its full editable content and original base selection.

If another operator changes the dossier, the current source and the earlier draft remain visible. Choose **Compare draft with current revision**. Fields untouched in the draft adopt the current saved value. Fields edited in both versions show their original, current and working values together. Select each resolution and choose **Use resolved draft on revision …**. The earlier complete draft remains available.

The form preserves an unacknowledged browser write in memory until IndexedDB confirms that exact draft version. If storage fails, the page offers the complete unsaved draft as a download and warns before closing while those unacknowledged edits remain.

## Recover a save whose reply was interrupted

The browser commits the original request ID and full payload before submitting it. An interrupted reply leaves **Retry original save** available. That action sends the same request and reopens the engine's original saved review when it already exists.

A saved server receipt is retained before the corresponding draft is removed. Edits made to the draft during a save remain their own complete branch. A rejected revision check leaves the full draft available for explicit comparison with the current state.

## Open the saved reports and portable dossier

Saved review history provides **Previous report** and **Reviewed report** downloads at their exact dossier revisions. Each offers HTML, Markdown and a complete portable dossier. **Current report** opens the selected current revision.

The report contains the source-linked findings and citation-review history. Reopen a portable JSON or gzip file through the existing **Open dossier file** action to continue from its original retained sources and revision history.

The review endpoint accepts a complete UTF-8 JSON request up to 16 MiB. The maintained dossier engine applies its original saved-revision size limit. A size or validation error leaves the complete browser draft and request available for correction or download.

## Use the existing Merchant tools

The same review is available through an attached Research workspace. The host's existing Research configuration selects its original listener connection file, workspace directory and private exports directory. Attach with `merchant_research_attach`; all citation operations use that attachment's `workspace` alias.

| Tool | Complete operation |
| --- | --- |
| `merchant_research_citation_updates` | Page notices, counts and source coverage at a selected dossier revision |
| `merchant_research_citation_update` | Open the complete notice, original assertions, affected evidence and findings, citation options and review history |
| `merchant_research_citation_review` | Save one explicit atomic review or recover that exact original request |

# ClinicalTrials retained-cohort analysis

This module turns an already received ClinicalTrials edition into a useful descriptive cohort review. It uses the original research question, retained study metadata and source identities, and creates local filters, readable reports and complete exports.

The input is the existing `sf88-research-results-v1` envelope returned by the ClinicalTrials workspace. It never opens another registry capture, purchase or provider workspace.

## Use the maintained source receiver

Read the edition through `workspace.edition(operationId)` or `workspace.retainedEdition(dossierId, editionId)`. Those maintained methods verify the original edition bytes and source packet before returning them. Pass the returned `sha256` directly as `editionSha256`; do not hash a reserialized JSON object.

~~~js
import {
  analyzeClinicalTrialsCohort,
  filterClinicalTrialsCohort,
  clinicalTrialsAnalysisPage,
  renderClinicalTrialsCohortCsv,
  renderClinicalTrialsCohortJson,
  renderClinicalTrialsCohortReport
} from './clinical-trials-analysis.mjs';

const retained = await workspace.edition(operationId);
const complete = analyzeClinicalTrialsCohort(retained.value, {
  editionSha256: retained.sha256
});

const selected = filterClinicalTrialsCohort(complete, {
  statuses: ['COMPLETED'],
  resultsFlags: [true]
});

const page = clinicalTrialsAnalysisPage(selected, {offset: 0, limit: 50});
const csv = renderClinicalTrialsCohortCsv(selected);
const json = renderClinicalTrialsCohortJson(selected);
const html = renderClinicalTrialsCohortReport(selected);
const markdown = renderClinicalTrialsCohortReport(selected, {format: 'md'});
~~~

The complete view remains available while filters change. Apply each filter selection to that complete view. Use the page only for a paginated screen; exporters accept the full selected analysis. A page slice is rejected by both filters and exporters to prevent partial rows being mistaken for the complete cohort.

The existing `examples/clinical-trials-dossier.mjs` is the full receiving workflow: retained packet, research question, original evidence and finding, report, portable export, separate receiving workspace and reopened source. Analysis attaches to that same retained edition after receiving.

## API

| Export | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `analyzeClinicalTrialsCohort(edition, {editionSha256})` | Complete deterministic analysis of one validated retained edition |
| `filterClinicalTrialsCohort(analysis, criteria)` | Full selected rows, refreshed groups and observations, original capture identity |
| `clinicalTrialsAnalysisPage(analysis, {offset, limit})` | A screen page of rows, with whole-selection groups and counts |
| `renderClinicalTrialsCohortCsv(analysis)` | Complete 24-column original-record inventory using quoted CSV cells and CRLF |
| `renderClinicalTrialsCohortJson(analysis)` | Complete analysis, exact source references and structured study fields |
| `renderClinicalTrialsCohortReport(analysis, {format})` | Self-contained HTML by default, or Markdown with `format: 'md'` |

There are no module imports, runtime package dependencies, time-dependent calculations or remote requests. Identical retained input and filters produce identical analysis and export content.

## Returned shape

The top level contains `schema`, `question`, `label`, `source`, `filters`, `selectedStudies`, `selectedOccurrences`, `excludedStudies`, `excludedOccurrences`, `rows`, `repeatedStudies`, `groups`, `observations` and `methods`.

The source retains the actual edition SHA-256, original packet and manifest SHA-256, capture and source identities, coverage, completeness, provider total, distinct-study and occurrence populations, repeated-study variants, page references, source version, original query configuration and source timestamps. A local filter never changes `source.captureStudies`, source coverage or the original query configuration. `selectedStudies` is the distinct-NCT denominator used for the displayed groups; `selectedOccurrences` is the count of retained rows. The corresponding source totals are `captureStudies` and `captureOccurrences`.

Each original record row includes:

- Stable occurrence ID (capture/page/row), NCT ID, titles, public registry URL, original status and status verification date.
- Study type, original phase array and a deterministic phase combination.
- Exact condition labels, interventions, intervention types and lead sponsor.
- The distinct source values `hasResults: true`, `false` or `null`, plus retained result-section names.
- Enrollment as exact source text, its reported type and an explicit presence flag.
- Date structures with their original date and type, annotated with year, month, day or unrecognized precision.
- Registered primary outcome measures.
- Original capture ID, page index, study index within that page, page URL, page SHA-256, record SHA-256 and record byte count.

Rows sort by NCT ID, source page index and original position within that page. Group rows sort by count descending, then exact label and serialized key, so outputs remain stable when a reader opens them again.

## Counting rules

| Group | Counting rule |
| --- | --- |
| Status, study type, lead sponsor, enrollment type | Distinct NCT IDs within each exact label; missing values are shown explicitly |
| Phase combinations | Sorted sets of original phase labels; PHASE1 + PHASE2 is one combination; NCT IDs are distinct within each group |
| Conditions, intervention types, result sections | Overlapping memberships; each exact label is counted at most once per study |
| Results flags | True, false and missing remain three separate groups |
| Results coverage | Cross-tabulation of the source results flag and presence of retained result sections |

Every group entry has `key`, `value`, `label`, `count`, `occurrences`, `studyIds`, `denominator` and `percent`. The count and denominator are distinct study IDs; occurrences is the number of source records that supplied that membership. For example, a status group has value `"COMPLETED"`; a phase group has value `["PHASE1", "PHASE2"]`; a results group has value `true`. UI controls should retain these typed values rather than reconstructing them from display labels.

Additional summaries count distinct study IDs with reported enrollment, reported zero enrollment, absent enrollment, registered primary outcome measures and missing metadata. Conditions and sponsor names are not combined by synonym or corporate family. Percentage memberships can total more than 100% where a study belongs to multiple labels.

Enrollment values stay as text because the packet reader preserves source numeric precision. A value such as `"0"` is reported enrollment, not absence. No total of unique patients is calculated across studies. Registered protocol outcome measures and posted result sections remain separate.

## Repeated and changed source records

Every source occurrence is preserved, including byte-identical repeats of an NCT ID. `repeatedStudies` lists repeated IDs with occurrence counts, distinct record-version counts, a changed flag, original record hashes and the occurrence IDs for each version. The original full-capture inventory also stays in `source.repeatedStudies` when local filters select fewer records.

The module never chooses the first or last occurrence as a replacement for other versions. All selected original rows appear in the CSV, JSON and report. The report identifies the original page and row for each occurrence.

If two retained versions of one study have different statuses, both status memberships are visible and that NCT ID counts once in each group. Consequently, status, type, phase, results and missing-field groups can overlap when a source capture contains changed versions. Observations call out repeated and changed studies explicitly. Byte-identical repeats do not increase a group's distinct-study count.

Filters match complete individual records. A status from one version is never combined with a results flag from another version to manufacture a match. The selection then counts distinct NCT IDs and selected occurrences separately.

## Local filters

| Criterion | Values |
| --- | --- |
| `statuses` | Exact status strings, or `null` for an absent status |
| `studyTypes` | Exact study type strings, or `null` |
| `phaseKeys` | The group's serialized `key`, such as `'["PHASE1","PHASE2"]'`; `'[]'` selects no reported phases |
| `conditions` | Exact condition strings; `null` selects studies with no condition labels |
| `sponsors` | Exact lead sponsor names, or `null` |
| `resultsFlags` | Boolean `true`, boolean `false`, or `null` |
| `hasResultsSections` | Boolean for presence or absence of retained result sections; `null` removes this criterion |
| `query` | Case-insensitive substring over NCT ID, titles, sponsor and conditions |

Values within one category are OR alternatives. Different categories are combined with AND. Missing criteria and empty category arrays leave that category unrestricted. An empty selection is a normal analysis result with zero selected studies and zero-denominator groups.

The list filters accept at most 200 values per field; the results flag list contains at most three values. Query text accepts at most 2,000 characters. A page uses nonnegative integer offset and a limit between 1 and 200; its default size is 50. Its rows and `page.total` count source occurrences, while the groups continue to use distinct-study denominators.

## Reports and exports

HTML and Markdown reports contain observations calculated from the selected source, all ten grouped reviews, the full selected original-record inventory, methods and source/filter details. The HTML is a standalone, neutral industrial layout with accessible table headers, local CSS, horizontal table scrolling and print styles. It contains no script or external resource. Source text is escaped.

The CSV includes every selected original study occurrence and its stable occurrence ID, including exact enrollment and date structures in JSON cells. Array and nested fields are also JSON cells, so combinations and precision survive export. The three states of the results flag are `true`, `false` and an empty cell. Formula-like free text receives a leading apostrophe for spreadsheet display; the structured JSON and retained source remain the authoritative exact text.

The analysis omits the large embedded source ZIP and complete raw study bodies from ordinary screen responses. Every occurrence's record and page identities remain present, including repeated and changed versions. The original source download and whole-study reader still provide complete protocol and results content.

## Integration

The source-owned operation and retained-edition route families can read this module through the existing authenticated Research workspace. Return `clinicalTrialsAnalysisPage` for a screen and render an export from the full filtered analysis. Preserve the existing file-download writer and metadata projection for large receiving operations.

The `ResearchWorkspaceClient.clinicalTrials()` facade, CLI and original ClinicalTrials pane should use the same route family. Use `group.key` for phase controls, `group.value` for typed status/results controls, `selectedStudies` for the displayed denominator and `source.captureStudies` for the retained capture count. Downloads must keep the current local criteria, independently of screen pagination.

Descriptions and counts apply to the original selected capture. A complete capture means the original capture completed its configured pagination; it does not expand the source query to the whole registry. The module makes no clinical recommendation, patient eligibility decision or treatment-effect calculation.

The complete packet is checked with Python's ZIP reader before intake: canonical declared member paths, no special files or duplicate members, bounded sizes, exact member hashes, exact original cursor/request/receipt bindings and semantic equality of original HTTP study objects and retained NDJSON objects. Retained dossier reads independently bind the original packet manifest, selected capture, per-page source digest and whole-source digest.

Source observations are not medical conclusions. Cohort membership and status describe the selected registry source. A study absent from another selected capture is reported as **absent from that capture**; the tool does not infer withdrawal. Equal provider version observations do not establish a transactional snapshot. Full source text and section-value changes are reported separately.
